top_signals.title: BofA's Subramanian Warns About Sitting on Cash Right Now
top_signals.summary: BofA Securities Head of US Equity and Quantitative Strategy Savita Subramanian warns investors about staying in cash right now as real returns are low. She says large-cap value stocks are a "beautiful story" and a better option. She speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)
